label: Jump to Latest
description: Chat transcript with jump to latest. Best for a read only 9 message thread on the provider defaults, with no client state, streaming or composer to strip out.

label: Streaming Reply
description: Streaming reply that follows the edge. Best for a reply typed out 4 characters every 28ms under a Working badge, with aria-busy on the log and a Replay stream button.

label: Anchored Turn
description: Anchored turn with a previous peek. Best for a composer form that sends questions and gets a canned answer after 900ms, each question lifted near the top under a 64px peek.

label: Opening Position
description: Opening position for a saved thread. Best for a Tabs switch over the 3 opening positions on a thread whose last answer outgrows the panel, with a day divider on top.

label: Load Earlier
description: Load earlier without losing your place. Best for a header Load earlier button adding 5 older turns per click to a 6 of 16 window, with a badge that reports whether the view can scroll up.

label: Thread Navigator
description: Thread navigator for stepping turns. Best for previous and next buttons around a turn counter and the current question, tracked from the anchor and jumped with smooth scrolling.
